name: The Westin Jackson
positioning: The Westin Jackson: a downtown Jackson, Mississippi hotel within walking distance of Thalia Mara Hall, with Soul Spa, an indoor saltwater pool and a Music Legends of Mississippi guitar package
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable base in downtown Jackson
Music lovers drawn to Mississippi's music heritage

facts.text: The Mississippi Coliseum is about one mile from the hotel.
The Westin Heavenly Bed has 10 layers of bedding.
All rooms have Westin Heavenly Bath White Tea bath and body products.
Suites have separate living and sleeping areas.
Soul Spa has separate men's and women's lounges.
The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio is open 24/7.
Guests can explore Jackson on the hotel's custom cruiser bicycles.
Estelle Southern Table serves modern Southern cuisine for breakfast, lunch, dinner and weekend brunch.

highlights.text: The Music Legends of Mississippi package lets guests play exact replica guitars of six pioneers of American music in their room.
The hotel has an indoor saltwater pool.
Soul Spa is a day spa offering massages, facials and other treatments.
The hotel is within walking distance of Thalia Mara Hall, the Russell C. Davis Planetarium and the Hinds County Courthouse.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
WhataHotel notes the immediate downtown area has limited leisure attractions.
